column4: ランスとその子供達はヘルマンに到着した

column5: Dark Rance is standing alone, staring intently at one spot.

column4: 現れたのは　ネプラカス爺体

column5: He harbors resentment against Dark Rance.

column5: You kept interfering over and over, for a half-breed, you devil's traitor.

column5: But even your prized treasure sword Gram was absorbed by Quelplan and weakened.

column4: 今日こそは殺してやるぞ。
column5: Today, I'll kill you for sure.

column5: Rance: 'Hmm, who is this old man? Do I know him?'

column5: Dark Rance: 'First class demon god Neplacus, a fellow scheming to conquer the world through demons.'

column5: Rance: 'Oh, so there's an idiot here trying to invade my world. I'll scatter him.'

column4: な、魔王ランスだと・・
